title: An xAPI course on getting the most out of agents, built by the workflow it teaches
description: I'd like to build an xAPI-compliant course with the workflow I have: one I can put on our LMS for people to work through, teaching them how to get the most out of agents. We're an e-learning company with a lot of learning designers, and I think the workflow could build learning courses as code just as well as it builds software, because courses are generally made of code. Not the presentation turned into a course: a course as well, that people can go through. (Ross, 2026-10-15, in the presentation repo's session; log in docs/conversations/2026-10-15-where-the-course-starts.md.)
